title: Leek and potato frittata
summary: Leek and potato frittata is a british dinner built around medium eggs and leeks, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

ingredients.prepNote: beaten if the method says so

steps.instruction: Pat medium eggs dry and season it. Prep leeks and new potatoes for Leek and potato frittata so the pan is not waiting.
steps.tip: Dry protein browns. Wet protein steams and turns grey.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil and cook medium eggs on both sides until done. Lift it out to rest.
In the same pan, cook leeks and new potatoes in the leftover juices until tender. Add any lemon, mustard or herbs.
steps.tip: Taste Leek and potato frittata before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Slice medium eggs and serve it with the vegetables and pan juices.  Check that the potatoes is tender, then serve.
